messages.subject: Help with calculateDiffMeth function
parts:
Hi, Altuna

I am trying to compute the differentially methylated regions with the function calculateDiffMeth. After reorganized the data:

methtiles.1.3 = reorganize(methtiles,sample.ids=c("Sample_1", "Sample_3"),
                      treatment=c(1,0))

I have applied:

mDifMeth.1.3 <- calculateDiffMeth(methtiles.1.3, num.cores = 8)

In my laptop, via RStudio, I got the following message:

"Error in pi0 * length(order_rawp) * order_rawp :
  non-numeric argument to binary operator
In addition: Warning message:
In parallel::mclapply(my.f.list, f.fisher, mc.cores = num.cores) :
  all scheduled cores encountered errors in user code"

In my workstation, via command line, direct in R:

"Error in unlist(parallel::mclapply(my.f.list, f.fisher, mc.cores = num.cores)) :
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'unlist': Error in mcfork() :
  unable to fork, possible reason: Cannot allocate memory"

(My workstation has 32 GB of memory RAM)

If I apply only the following command:
 
mDifMeth.1.3 <- calculateDiffMeth(methtiles.1.3)
"Error in lo:hi : NA/NaN argument"

Could you please give me a suggestion on how to solve this issue?

Best Regards,

Robersy

NOTE: Please find enclosed the variable methtiles.1.3 in the file methtiles.1.3.RData
